summary: Default the MCP streamable-HTTP transport to 127.0.0.1:7777 instead of the generator's wildcard :7777, and require a bearer secret on any non-loopback bind.
reason: The generated MCP server exposes every tool in this CLI, including mutations that send messages, delete contacts, and modify tags, and those tools act with the operator's Respond.io token. The streamable-HTTP transport performs no inbound authentication of its own, so the wildcard default bind published credentialed workspace tooling to any host that could reach the port, and an explicit --addr bind was equally unauthenticated. This patch makes loopback the default and, for any non-loopback bind, requires RESPONDIO_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN and enforces 'Authorization: Bearer' with a constant-time compare; without the secret the server refuses to start rather than serving unauthenticated. The generator emits the wildcard default and no auth boundary for every CLI, so the durable fix belongs in the Printing Press template; this patch hardens the shipped binary in the meantime.
